checks.description: Codex checks each exact edit and hash before accepting artifact, then applies, compiles and regression-tests separately.
checks.message: Codex must supply actual review evidence

result.reviewEvidence: Read all proposed edits across eight targets, including whole sequence allocator, profile cache behavior, report aggregate join and unit-dialog failure paths. Raw SHA and exact-match validation passed for every edit. Artifact JSON parsed successfully. Accept artifact only, not test completion. Parent will explicitly roll back runtime allocator failures, narrow missing-table detection, validate overflow before write, and avoid phone-prefix truncation. Stock guards returning false are valid rejection and regression must assert false, not require exception. Actual source compile and fresh DB integration tests follow application.
